data.readmeSummary:
## UK Company Accounts – Turnover, Profit & Net Assets (No API Key)

Extracts headline financial figures from Companies House Accounts Data Product daily iXBRL bulk files: turnover, gross profit, operating profit, profit after tax, cash, debtors, stock, net assets, equity, average employees, previous-period comparatives and turnover growth. The Actor downloads and parses tagged iXBRL facts at scale (daily bulk files covering tens of thousands of filings), extracts numeric monetary values in GBP and employee counts, computes growth metrics, and provides filing metadata and source references. It supports filtering and selection by financial thresholds and company identifiers and operates without needing a Companies House API key.

## Use cases

- Build prospect lists by company size and recent filings (filter by turnover, net assets, cash, profit and headcount).  
- Check the latest filed financial figures for specific company numbers.  
- Filter fresh filers for B2B sales and lead generation based on recent accounts and headline metrics.  
- Spot growing or cash-rich companies and identify new or changed year-ends for accountants, brokers, lenders and M&A advisers.  
- Pull latest headline numbers for credit checks and supplier risk assessments across lists of companies.  
- Bulk analysis of company performance across thousands of iXBRL filings for researchers and journalists.
